scripts.build: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:main
scripts.build:main: esbuild main/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --external:electron --external:playwright --format=esm --outfile=dist-main/main/index.js && esbuild main/platform/speech/speech-worker.ts --bundle --platform=node --external:electron --external:sherpa-onnx-node --format=esm --outfile=dist-main/main/platform/speech/worker.mjs && esbuild preload/bridge.ts --bundle --platform=node --external:electron --format=cjs --outfile=dist-main/preload/bridge.cjs && node -e "const{cpSync,mkdirSync}=require('node:fs');mkdirSync('dist-main/main/templates',{recursive:true});cpSync('main/templates','dist-main/main/templates',{recursive:true})"
scripts.test:unit:slow: vitest run tests/unit/worktree-isolation.test.ts tests/unit/project-git.test.ts tests/unit/platform-services.test.ts tests/unit/snapshot-documents.test.ts
scripts.test:acceptance:sprint0: npm run build && vitest run tests/acceptance/sprint0
scripts.test:all: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration && npm run test:regression:sprint0 && npm run test:regression:sprint1 && npm run test:acceptance:sprint0 && npm run test:acceptance:sprint1 && npm run test:acceptance:sprint2 && npm run test:acceptance:sprint3
